Almost 22,000 disposable water bottles were eliminated at Intel events 
through use of bulk water stations.

More than 77,000 gallons of diesel were saved by consolidating freight 
for four major events onto fewer trucks.

499 metric tons of Renewable Energy Certificates were purchased  
to help offset the energy used at the Intel Developer Forum in  
San Francisco.

All paper printing at the Intel Capital Global Summit was eliminated  
with the exception of the agenda, which was printed on 100%  
recycled paper.

Energy consumption during the keynote speech at the Intel Developer 
Forum in Beijing, China, was reduced by more than 50% through the 
use of energy-efficient lights, projectors, and speaker systems.
